outcome: Maternal morbidity (shock, adult respiratory distress syndrome, coagulopathy, loss of fertility due to hysterectomy)
cohort: N/A - This is a review discussing the management of postpartum hemorrhage, not a study of a specific cohort.
finding: Transcatheter uterine artery embolization (UAE) is highlighted as a nonsurgical, minimally invasive, extremely safe, and effective treatment for postpartum hemorrhage, which is currently underused due to limited awareness among referring providers.
